source: 陶淵明 飲酒二十首 其五 (10 lines, 逯欽立/中華書局 text of record) ↔ Arthur Waley, A Hundred and Seventy Chinese Poems (1918), poem (7) (10 lines).

map.note: 結廬在人境 ↔ 'I built my hut in a zone of human habitation' — 結廬/built my hut, 人境/zone of human habitation.
而無車馬喧 ↔ 'Yet near me there sounds no noise of horse or coach' — 無…喧/no noise, 車馬/horse or coach.
問君何能爾 ↔ 'Would you know how that is possible?' — 問君/would you know, 何能爾/how that is possible.
心遠地自偏 ↔ 'A heart that is distant creates a wilderness round it' — 心遠/a heart that is distant, 地自偏/creates a wilderness round it.
採菊東籬下 ↔ 'I pluck chrysanthemums under the eastern hedge' — 採菊/pluck chrysanthemums, 東籬下/under the eastern hedge.
悠然見南山 ↔ 'Then gaze long at the distant summer hills' — 悠然見/gaze long, 南山/the (southern→'summer') hills. Waley renders 南 'southern' as 'summer'; the referent (the hills) is preserved.

TARGET. 山氣日夕佳 ↔ 'The mountain air is fresh at the dusk of day' — 山氣/mountain air, 日夕/the dusk of day, 佳/fresh(good). This is the crossing of interest: 夕 (MOE dark, 傍晚) × Waley's 'dusk' (Skeat [dark,dim]).
飛鳥相與還 ↔ 'The flying birds two by two return' — 飛鳥/the flying birds, 相與/two by two, 還/return.
此中有真意 ↔ 'In these things there lies a deep meaning' — 此中/in these things, 真意/a deep (true) meaning.
欲辨已忘言 ↔ 'Yet when we would express it, words suddenly fail us' — 欲辨/would express(discern), 已忘言/words fail us. (The 辨/辯 variant does not touch this alignment.)

confidence: Very high. The two texts are strictly 1:1, ten lines each, in the same order, with no fusion, split, drop, or addition. The only rendering liberties (南山 'southern hills' → 'summer hills'; 佳 'good' → 'fresh') are within-line word choices, not line-boundary events, so they leave the map an identity. Soft spot: none at the line grain.
